# Fixtures

This directory contains controlled, repeatable Spec2Primitives inputs, including
test-only ontology fixtures. Fixtures must reference reviewed local sources and
must not be presented as an authoritative production TBox, live robot state, or
physical-execution evidence. Current proposal-v8, completion-v6, catalog, and
structural-draft fixtures exercise contracts only and do not establish
production behavior. Future bundle, binding, execution-validation, and
execution fixtures have the same limitation.
